mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior month compresses discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without regime dependence.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS declines in prior month but S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.2 percentage points signals labor market deterioration, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE increases by >0.2pp in a month but S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and industrial production indicate broad economic slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST and INDPRO both decline in same month but S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: During high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.0% YoY), monetary tightening (FEDFUNDS > 5.0%) causes negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL > 3.0% and FEDFUNDS > 5.0% but S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signals strong economic activity, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: RSAFS increases in prior month but S&P 500 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in non-farm payrolls exceeding 100,000 signals labor market weakness, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: PAYEMS declines by >100,000 in a month but S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous industrial production growth and housing starts decline indicate supply-demand mismatch, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO increases and HOUST declines in same month but S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions (GDPC1 growth > 3.0% annualized), housing starts decline signals impending slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: GDPC1 growth > 3.0% annualized and HOUST declines but S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of cases.
